branchKey.main: Canonical trunk. Carries the CLI, the ground rules, and the finished reference templates — but no rival in-progress designs. Branch every new piece of work off this.
branchKey.template/<archetype>: Convention for in-progress work designing a NEW industry template.
branchKey.mockup/<lead-slug>: Convention for a per-lead mockup instantiated from a finished archetype.
branchKey.fresh-start: Pre-consolidation branch where the home-services reference template + the site.mjs CLI were built. Now folded into main; kept as backup.
branchKey.claude/loving-rubin-sn4iaf: Pre-consolidation branch where the construction reference template (midstate-construction) was built. Now folded into main; kept as backup. (construction-template-mockup-1 is a duplicate of it.)
branchKey.template/outdoor-services: Branch where the outdoor-services reference template (complete-lawn-service-ms) was built. Now folded into main; kept as backup.
branchKey.archive/scaffold-generation: TAG. The abandoned pre-"fresh start" generation: 53 scaffolded Tailwind/{{TOKEN}} mockups + scripts/scaffold.js, including a construction "Site Plan" redesign. Preserved for reference only — do NOT build from it (design isolation).
branchKey.archive/home-services-v1: TAG. An earlier home-services design direction, superseded. Reference only.
branchKey.other-preserved: Old auto-named branches (claude/vigilant-ride-9c43zu, claude/sharp-pasteur-43k2e1, claude/brave-fermat-scv4ws, add-claude-skills, home-services-template-v1, construction-template-mockup-2-site-plan) are preserved on the remote but superseded. Do not build from them.
